issue: Original R18 FIT return action = group%2 and B sign = +1 if even group else -1, leaving missing B×return-action support and no reliable causal action credit.
hypothesis: With fully crossed factual B sign × A sign × selected return action support, can targeted return-A prediction credit make native Hybrid retrieve early factual A identity across eight indistinguishable B effects and choose the correct action before any return-A outcome? Fully trained conventional readout proves task identification from same observed FIT data.

B.sign: even group +1, odd group -1; no A-sign linkage

source.FIT_counts: 32 groups ×2 A signs ×2 observed return-action arms=128 actual factual episodes; 32 examples per B×selected-return-action cell, each has both A signs
source.model_causal_input: P80 factual action/effect; current effect masked, only earlier chosen outcomes visible; no hidden sign, oracle, counterfactual label

training.loss_formula: existing native or conventional factual physical loss + focus_weight*mean_squared_normalized_physical_delta_at_factual_selected_return_step9
training.checkpoint_selected: always fixed final step160; never pick by DEV or SCORE

learned_memory_control.kind: two-coefficient ridge on factual early-A physical delta to factual action0 return delta, independently learned action1 return mean from observed action1
learned_memory_control.source: FIT episodes only, exact selected return-action labels, no hidden regime/target from evaluator
learned_memory_control.prediction: action0: fitted [intercept, earlyA physical delta] ; action1: FIT mean observed physical return delta for action1

evaluation.pair_unit: one group contains both A signs and both crossed goals
evaluation.primary: mean one-step model-selected factual action regret vs evaluator-only post-action two-action best; lower better
evaluation.sign_contrast: count matched A− vs A+ first-return action contrasts at identical B and goal (max 32)
evaluation.firstA_erase: replace only early factual A effect with zero before querying; positive mechanism should lose useful A information
evaluation.conventional_dev_selection: best 1 of 9 conventional instances on separate DEV only, no testing-driven selection
evaluation.pass_candidate: in at least 2 of 3 native-return-focus seeds, mean score regret <=.90*strongest history-free control 0.015 AND <= DEV-selected conventional score+1e-4 AND >=24/32 A contrast pairs AND erased-A regret exceeds intact by >=.005 AND paired 16-group bootstrap 2.5% positive over history-free control; FIT-only memory control demonstrates <.001 average regret
evaluation.independence_note: even a native dev PASS is NOT original external scientific PASS; controls remain bounded update budget and unequal parameter/compute
